video.title: Example product explainer: follow a machine process
video.description: A generic machinery explainer is included as a format example. It does not depict a partner’s service, client work or validated process.
video.label: Fictional concept sample · English narration
transcript: A machine is easier to understand when you can follow the work. Start with one part entering the line.
Inside, a sequence of stages turns a complicated system into a process you can see.
The important story is how the work moves from one stage to the next: what comes in, what happens in between, and what comes out.
When customers can follow that sequence, they have a clearer way to understand where the machine fits and what to ask next.

faqs.question: Who is this page type for?
faqs.answer: It is a starting template for consultancies, system integrators and compliance or software partners that explain multiple service lines.

faqs.question: Does a video replace a partner’s advice or deliverables?
faqs.answer: No. It can introduce a service and set context; client-specific advice and formal deliverables remain with the qualified partner team.

faqs.question: Can the same explainer be used by both teams?
faqs.answer: A jointly reviewed overview can support shared outreach, proposals and client education, subject to both organizations approving the content and brand use.

faqs.question: What must be confirmed before sharing a partner page?
faqs.answer: Confirm the partner’s services, audience, brand permissions, claims, contact destination and any client-specific examples with the partner owner.

cta.title: Which service line should we explain first?
cta.body: Choose one partner audience and one recurring client question. We can shape a concise concept around the next conversation.
